prompt: Who was the Mayor of Quincy, Massachusetts when the Quincy Medical Center opened and who was the Mayor when it closed?
answer:
Quincy Medical Center opened in **1890**, during the mayoral term of **George W. Williams**, Quincy’s first mayor.

It closed permanently in **2020**, while **Thomas P. Koch** was mayor. (Its acute-care hospital closed in December 2014, also during Koch’s tenure.)
